description: Deterministic in-memory synthetic fixture datasets for visual evidence capture

routes.GET /api/public/properties: Returns single active property Khách sạn Sài Gòn Central
routes.GET /api/public/properties/:slug/room-ty: Returns 2 room types: Deluxe Double Room & Executive Suite
routes.GET /api/public/properties/:slug/availab: Returns room availability with synthetic estimated prices
routes.GET /api/public/bookings/:token: Returns hold booking (PendingPayment) or confirmed booking (Confirmed) with masked PII
routes.GET /api/reservations: Returns paginated list of reservations for staff
routes.GET /api/reservations/:id/folio: Returns Folio statement breakdown with payment audit history
